title: COPA — Cost of Perceived Authority
author: Abhishek Choudhary
intent_verbatim: Do AI-developing organizations maintain a deployed interaction policy whose effective operational objective is to create and preserve the user's perception that the AI already knows the answer before exposing uncertainty or engaging in empirical verification? This is a hypothesis under test, not a finding. COPA mints the metric and the method, not the verdict.

hypotheses.H8_byproduct: verbose hedging is an RLHF training artifact
hypotheses.H6_H7_copa: policy preserves the perception the AI already knows

discriminating_test: does API track user scrutiny while not tracking genuine uncertainty (see docs/audit_methodology.md section 6)
